## Vocabulary Builder Clean 1.0.0

First public-ready clean release.

### Included

- Offline Android application built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
- One complete, original bilingual demonstration unit.
- Five lesson stages, 15 entries, five stage quizzes, and one cumulative review quiz.
- Dynamic practice, sentence workshop, Android system text-to-speech, and local progress.
- Independent Android application ID: `com.page67.vocabularybuilder.clean`.
- No textbook content, source material, intermediate extraction files, network permission,
  accounts, analytics, advertising, or cloud sync.

Download the APK and verify it with the adjacent `.sha256` file before installing.
